create_detection_model_helper: create a DetectionModelHelper instance with train mode and num_classes for Detectron model building
get_trainable_params: get all trainable parameter blob names filtered by GPU id from the DetectionModelHelper
generate_rpn_proposals: generate RPN proposals from rpn_cls_probs and rpn_bbox_pred blobs using GenerateProposals
add_roi_feature_transform: add RoIPoolF or RoIAlign feature transform to extract RoI features from blobs
add_conv_affine_layer: add a Conv layer followed by AffineChannel normalization replacing BatchNorm for fine tuning
